raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Motivation

DSpark sampling and greedy verification on NPU still use several PyTorch operations in the inference path. This PR integrates the Triton implementations from sgl-kernel-npu through sampling interfaces compatible with the GPU implementations.

Requires the companion sgl-kernel-npu change at 23feeece4c.

Modifications

  • Add platform dispatch through ops/sampling/renorm.py, including the MarkovSampleStep entry point.
  • Route NPU Markov greedy sampling, row argmax, and temperature softmax through sgl-kernel-npu.
  • Route the shared DFlash/DSpark acceptance-length and bonus-token calculation through the fused NPU implementation.
  • Preserve existing CUDA and CPU execution paths.

Accuracy Tests

Validated SGLang 4a843b025c with sgl-kernel-npu 23feeece4c on 8 Ascend 910C cards, using TP=16 and attention DP=16.

Test case: test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_gpqa

Model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-w8a8.

Evaluated all 198 GPQA Diamond questions with batch size 128, temperature=1, top_p=1, high thinking effort, and max_tokens=125000. The harness used local weights/dataset paths and installed EvalScope, with one evaluation attempt per variant.

Metric | Parent baseline | This change -- | -- | -- Correct answers | 178/198 | 180/198 Accuracy | 89.90% | 90.91% Weighted draft acceptance rate | 39.66% | 39.19% Weighted acceptance length, including bonus | 3.379 | 3.351

Mean TPOT changed from 13.494 to 13.461 ms for greedy sampling and from 20.766 to 20.467 ms for probability sampling. All measured cases completed 128/128 requests.

These are single warmed measurements; repeated-run variance is unknown. Initial runs showed higher latency: GPQA mean TTFT increased from 9.99 to 32.93 seconds, and mean TPOT from 66.70 to 176.49 ms. Further profiling is needed to explain these initialization-inclusive differences. No GPU performance-parity claim is made.

Checklist

  • [ ] Format code with pre-commit.
  • [ ] Add or update unit tests.
  • [ ] Update documentation where needed.
  • [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results where applicable.
  • [ ] Follow the SGLang code-style guidance.
